notes.title: Update 1.0.2 - Global Click Madness!
notes.content:
We've added a global Steam Leaderboard that records your clicks! 🌍💥
Now you can prove to the world that you waste time the best! ⏳😎

Steam Items have been temporarily removed (don’t worry, they might return 👀).
Various improvements and bug fixes – because even wasted time should run smoothly.
Click away and claim your rightful place in the Hall of Time Wasters! 🏆🔥
